title: Live reasoning: one stream with a live agent list
question: Your pick: one stream like Pi, with the focus idea moved into the agent list instead of a card row. The conversation replays a real Pi turn (claude-opus-5-5 lead, 6 Nov 12:26). The other agents' snippets are real recorded thoughts and commands from gpt-6-astra sessions; their titles, timings, and the todos are illustrative. “Build this” records a design preference only.

options.label: One stream, with a live agent list
options.thesis: The conversation is the Pi session: your message, the agent's thinking (italic) and tool calls ($ command, output tail) in recorded order, then the reply. A finished turn folds its work into one line. The left column lists agents as Working and Not working; each working row shows its phase, elapsed time, model, and its newest thought or command, and the selected row follows the live stream.
options.viewport: 1600 × 1000 at the live edge; also 1280 × 800, 900 × 800, and a history capture with the earlier turn opened.
options.risk: Five or more working agents push idle ones below the fold; the Working group may need its own scroll limit.
